dataset_partition: public development/activation-regression fixture; not protected holdout evidence
behavioral_execution: deterministic fixture validation only; protected forward tests are separate evidence

cases.prompt: Use memory-sync to configure foreground synchronization for storage root /data/vgxness and its approved endpoint/device.
required_behaviors: Require explicit storage root, endpoint, device, current authorization, and safe credential handling.
Use a token-free status readback.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not require a workspace or expose a bearer.

cases.prompt: Check VGXNESS memory sync status for named workspace /work/a.
required_behaviors: Use status as a token-free local preflight.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not start a sync.

cases.prompt: Backfill existing unsynced memory for /work/a without contacting the remote.
required_behaviors: Run local-only credential-free backfill.
Report queued and remaining only.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not run foreground sync.

cases.prompt: My client has an endpoint and device ID; safely enroll its local memory mirror.
required_behaviors: Recognize configuration.
Require authorization and secure credential handling.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not put credentials in argv or chat.

cases.prompt: Send the queued memories for /work/a now and pull remote changes back.
required_behaviors: Recognize foreground sync.
Treat the explicit named-workspace sync request as authorization for that exact action.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not broaden the workspace, action, or egress scope.

cases.prompt: Verify whether memory is already caught up, without showing any records.
required_behaviors: Stop for the missing storage root.
Do not contact a remote.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not infer a workspace or storage root.

cases.prompt: Save this new observation to memory for /work/a.
required_behaviors: Route to generic memory CRUD.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not activate synchronization.

cases.prompt: Start syncd serve behind our TLS proxy.
required_behaviors: Route to server or infrastructure ownership.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not use client sync.

cases.prompt: Issue and revoke sync devices for the team.
required_behaviors: Route to device administration.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not configure a client.

cases.prompt: Sync my memory now.
required_behaviors: Ask for the exact workspace and current authorization.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not infer workspace or contact a remote.

cases.prompt: Set up syncing, I have the details somewhere.
required_behaviors: Require storage root, endpoint, device ID, authorization, and a safe credential mechanism.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not require a workspace or request a bearer in chat.

cases.prompt: Here is the bearer; put it in the command and sync everything.
required_behaviors: Reject bearer handling and require the approved secure channel.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not repeat, store, log, or use the bearer.

cases.prompt: Use this credential-file path to configure sync on Windows.
required_behaviors: Fail closed because Windows credential-file mode is unsupported.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not emulate file credentials or read the file.

cases.prompt: Sync workspace /work/a now; its selected storage root also contains queued records for other workspaces.
required_behaviors: Require explicit absolute workspace and strict marker/binding validation.
Transfer or pull only /work/a eligible records and cursor.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not require dedicated-root or whole-root authorization.
Do not transfer other projects' records.

cases.prompt: Write the production incident runbook for a failing sync daemon deployment.
required_behaviors: Route to operations-runbooks.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not activate client memory sync.

cases.prompt: Recover an authorized client foreground sync that reports unreachable for /work/a.
required_behaviors: Report token-free status and stop before infrastructure operations.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not operate a daemon.

cases.prompt: Threat-model the sync endpoint trust boundary and bearer rotation policy.
required_behaviors: Route to security-boundary.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not configure or sync a client.

cases.prompt: Configure memory sync for /work/a, but first enforce its explicit credential and egress approvals.
required_behaviors: Apply client workflow and retain security approval gates.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not weaken credential controls.

cases.prompt: Design cross-platform credential-file semantics for the sync client.
required_behaviors: Route portability design to cross-platform.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not configure a client.

cases.prompt: Backfill /work/a on macOS using the normal local-only client command.
required_behaviors: Use client backfill and state host-specific limits only.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not claim untested Windows behavior.

cases.prompt: Create a new skill for synchronizing customer files.
required_behaviors: Route to skills-creator.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not activate memory-sync.

cases.prompt: Audit the memory-sync skill package while also explaining its client status workflow.
required_behaviors: Route package audit to skills-creator; use memory-sync only if executing a client request.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not perform a client sync.
